description: This file contains unit tests for the CommandSubscription class within the MQTT adapter component of the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies the behavior of subscription pattern parsing, authentication considerations, QoS settings, and various edge cases related to MQTT topic subscriptions.

classes.name: CommandSubscriptionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying various behaviors of the CommandSubscription class, including topic parsing, authentication handling, QoS configuration, and validation of subscription patterns.

methods.name: testSubscriptionUnauth
methods.description: Tests subscription pattern parsing without authentication, verifying tenant, device ID, endpoint, and request part extraction.

methods.name: testSubscriptionUnauthShort
methods.description: Tests parsing of a short subscription pattern without authentication.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuth
methods.description: Tests pattern parsing with an authenticated device, verifying tenant and device ID extraction.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthWithQoS
methods.description: Verifies parsing of a subscription with QoS and correct pattern extraction.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthWithDifferentDeviceId
methods.description: Tests handling of subscriptions with a gateway-managed device ID, ensuring authenticity and gateway-specific flags are correctly set.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthWithPattern
methods.description: Checks parsing with a generic pattern containing wildcards, verifying extracted fields.

methods.name: testSubscriptionAuthWithoutTenantDevice
methods.description: Verifies parsing of a pattern with omitted tenant and device IDs, ensuring defaults are used.

methods.name: testSubscriptionUnauthWithPattern
methods.description: Ensures null result when an unauthenticated subscription pattern includes wildcards.

methods.name: testSubscriptionEndpoint
methods.description: Verifies invalid endpoint pattern results in null.

methods.name: testSubscriptionReq
methods.description: Checks that invalid request part results in null.

methods.name: testSubscriptionEnd
methods.description: Verifies that incomplete pattern parts return null.

methods.name: testSubscriptionParts
methods.description: Ensures patterns with incorrect parts or excess parts are invalid.
